answer_1.quote: We generate abstractive evidence from free text notes by prompting an LLM with appropriate queries.
answer_1.outputs: abstractive evidence snippets from EHR text

answer_4.quote: To assess the viability of clinicians using this model in practice, we collect in-depth annotations intended to simulate the real-world use of this technology.
answer_4.guideline: We first ask if a diagnosis is noted explicitly in the patient's record... Then, we show the annotator the model predictions and ask if the predicted risk for the conditions aligns with intuition... The annotator notes the usefulness of the evidence with respect to each condition.
